unit: Provider-reported input plus output model tokens, across every agent and both repositories. Count cached input once as input and reasoning only when not already included in output.
estimate_quality: Uncalibrated engineering allowance based on reuse, not measured forecast, monetary quote or guarantee.
continuity: Any PCE1 implementation expenditure already incurred toward the same revision counts against this shared ceiling; renaming the plan does not reset the budget. Record any unknown prior expenditure.
policy: Allocations guide effort; the responsible coordinator may redistribute them within the shared ceiling.
No fixed delegate-launch, parallel-head, concurrent-worker or test-pass quotas. Choose concurrency only where existing ownership/isolation supports it and expected savings exceed coordination cost.
Use existing telemetry and one compact usage checkpoint per outcome; do not create an accounting platform. Report incomplete metering rather than asserting a verified cap.
Do not change the user-selected expensive model upward automatically. Choose cheaper suitable configured agents for mechanics, tests and maintenance.
Reserve covers demonstrated gaps inside the six outcomes, not a new orchestration framework.
When remaining allowance cannot cover required validation and a safe handoff, checkpoint and stop; do not weaken acceptance.
Unchanged failure repetition is not progress. A new attempt needs a changed input, hypothesis or environment; this is not an arbitrary retry-count prohibition.
enforcement: Stop-work instruction and existing host/provider budget controls where available. This file is not a billing limiter.
